A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 19-page DiVE-k paper, including Appendices A.1–A.5. Text and rendered pages match throughout except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments, ablations and qualitative comparisons in Section 4, plus backbone experiments and inference-time measurements in Appendices A.3–A.4.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main classification comparisons and the appendix backbone and inference-time experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical top-k option mining, MCQ construction, GRPO training, reward definitions and two-step inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Oxford Flowers, CUB, Oxford Pets, Stanford Cars and FGVC Aircraft under the same base-to-novel, mixed-dataset and four-shot scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding experiments, including CLIP, Qwen2.5-VL, SFT, ViRFT, inference variants, proprietary models and the appendix Gemma3 comparisons.

E3.justification: Class splits, four-shot sampling, accuracy/HM metrics, LLM-based answer evaluation, training budgets and generation settings are unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains the same timing protocol over 500 samples.

E4.justification: Both retain the same option-generation ablations, K sensitivity, vision/text component ablations, two-stage accuracy analysis, qualitative cases, ViRFT shortcut analysis and computation-cost comparison.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports experimental seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests; the existing averaging practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. Examples include DiVE-k's average HM of 79.8 in Table 1 and four-shot accuracy of 74.75 in Table 3; appendix backbone and timing results also remain identical.

T1.justification: Section 3's mathematical definitions and Equations 1–4 are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about top-k-driven differential reasoning, verifiable MCQ rewards and improved generalization across the evaluated settings.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including dependence on initial Pass@k accuracy, additional inference cost and the proposed future verification of reasoning traces in Section 5.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters, prompt templates, evaluator identity, code link and release statements are identical in Section 4.1, Section 7 and Appendix A.1.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical, as are the paper's positioning relative to FuDD, ViRFT and prior reasoning methods.

P1.justification: Only the first-page marginal stamp changes from arXiv:2511.18305v1, dated 23 Nov 2025, to arXiv:2511.18305v2, dated 27 Jan 2026. Body wording, headings and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9, Tables 1–11, captions, placement and page layout are identical. The updated marginal version/date text does not reorganize the layout.

improvement.justification: The complete scientific content, appendices and presentation remain unchanged apart from the arXiv version/date stamp and its associated version link. This administrative update provides no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
